messages.subject: Given theta compute LogLike value for GPCM/nominal model
parts:
Hi,
I trained a GPCM/nominal model with the mirt package. For some reason(let me know if you are interested to know, long story), given theta (assume i know it) I need to compute the log likelihood (LL) value for a question and it's different response category. Since i have to compute it in python (i can not use the mirt package), can anyone please point me to a document that shows the functional form (equation) of LL for the GPCM/nominal model that can be coded in any language (i will use python)?

Thanks in advance for your help.

Regards, 
Azman Sami
